mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_card_performance_snapshots ( performance_snapshot_id, user_card_id, performance_month, current_spend_amount, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{performanceSnapshotId}, #{userCardId}, #{performanceMonth}, #{currentSpendAmount}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_spend_amount = VALUES(current_spend_amount), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
